cwd: the materialized fixture vault (no path flag in argv)
description: The environment every recorded case ran under. The caller's environment is cleared and rebuilt from this allowlist so nothing the host carries can reach a case.
notes: `{{VAULT_ROOT}}` in a case's `plan_template` is a third thing, and deliberately spelled unlike the others: it is an INPUT token the recording substituted for the vault path before invoking, where the placeholders above are OUTPUT substitutions applied after.
The locale is pinned rather than forwarded: glyph selection reads LC_ALL -> LC_CTYPE -> LANG, so a forwarded host locale makes the recorded glyph set a property of the recording machine.
HOME and the XDG bases point into a scratch tree owned by the run, so any registry, cache, config, socket or log a binary creates for itself is created fresh and discarded with the run.
XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is a short temp dir: it holds an AF_UNIX socket path, and a long base overruns sun_path.
A read case shares one materialized vault per fixture; a mutating case gets a fresh vault of its own so its writes reach no other case.

extraction_masks.note: Applied by the extraction itself, proven necessary by re-running the whole catalog twice and requiring byte equality between the runs. A case declares the ones that fired on it in its `volatile_masks` field. A mask fires only on a NONEMPTY value: an empty field is a fact about the invocation — a write-free path mints no telemetry id and computes no plan hash — so an empty value is recorded verbatim and the case declares no mask.

values.<PLAN_HASH>: a plan hash computed over the absolute vault root, so it tracks the temporary directory
values.<TRACE_ID>: a telemetry id minted per invocation

inherited_normalizations.dropped: Every other harness substitution is a COMPARISON device: it existed to make two binaries' outputs comparable by erasing a value or deleting a line that one side emitted and the other did not. Each destroys information a recording is supposed to carry, so none is applied. Three were dropped: the two that erased a telemetry id and a plan hash (which made a minted-but-volatile value indistinguishable from one that was never minted — the extraction masks above replace them and keep the two apart), and one that deleted the `self-update` row from the top-level command list, a row the binary really emits.
inherited_normalizations.note: The recording harness's substitutions. Exactly one is kept, and it is applied to EVERY invocation but declared only on the cases whose bytes it changed — a declaration naming a substitution the reader cannot find in the recording teaches nothing. A case declares it in its `normalizations` field, never in `volatile_masks`.

values.<VAULT>: written by the `vault-root` normalization: the absolute path of the materialized fixture vault, in every spelling the platform reports. Kept because the path is a property of the temporary directory the run created, so recording it would pin a value that cannot reproduce.

placeholders.note: Recorded output is verbatim apart from the four placeholders below, and there are no others. They come from two mechanisms, and a case declares each in its own field: never read one as the other.
